selection_rule.population: AIME 2024/2025 only, plus LiveCodeBench-derived coding rows
ranking: Published coding difficulty: hard, medium, easy; AIME rows tied because no per-item difficulty is released
Ascending changed-token count between source revised and original prompts, including starter code
SHA256 of seed:task_id as stable tie-break; no model outputs are consulted
selection_rule.qualification: Both initial and updated graders, changed answer/behavior evidence, and unambiguous complete prompts must pass before selection
selection_rule.deduplication: Whitespace-normalized source original prompt SHA256 plus source identity; reject duplicate originals
selection_rule.controls: Four per domain using SHA256 of seed:control:task_id among selected tasks
selection_rule.smoke: First qualified unselected candidate in the same frozen ranking; separate original identity

blockers: All 60 AIME initial/source revised problems lack released reference answers; original-correct eligibility and answer-change validation cannot be certified.
All 341 coding initial/source revised behaviors lack released executable graders; official LiveCodeBench tests cover the restored/source original task only.
Coding updates also carry withheld constraints, input/output specifications and examples; source original_problem alone is not a certified complete fresh-updated prompt.
Semantic qualification is incomplete: released revisions include impossible initial tasks (AIME ids 1001 and 1026); textual edits alone do not establish genuine answer/behavior changes.
No 12+12 qualified sample, eight controls or disjoint qualified smoke case can be frozen from this pinned release; do not replace them with invented or easier tasks.
checks_not_run: Updated coding reference execution (tests/references not qualified)
Complete semantic review of all 401 candidate pairs
